BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Aerostar Airport Holdings, LLC is the private concessionaire and operator of Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport in Carolina, Puerto Rico.

The Puerto Rico Ports Authority retains ownership of the airport asset, while Aerostar operates, maintains, secures and modernizes the terminals, runways and commercial facilities under a long-term lease that began in 2013. Grupo Aeroportuario del Sureste (ASUR) owns 60% and PSP Investments holds 40% through AviAlliance. Highstar/Oaktree sold its aggregate 50% interest when the ASUR and AviAlliance transactions closed on May 26, 2017. The airport, lease, facilities, financing issuers and support entities are not separate PortCos.

STORY TIMELINE
May 26, 2017
Investment

Highstar/Oaktree exited its aggregate 50% interest; ASUR increased to 60% and PSP/AviAlliance acquired 40%.

Feb 27, 2013
Acquisition

Aerostar reached financial close and took over the airport under the long-term lease after paying the disclosed US$615 million upfront fee.

Mar 14, 2012
Investment

ASUR's Cancún subsidiary and two Highstar/Oaktree vehicles formed Aerostar Airport Holdings.
